summary: Anonymous Linux native addon auto-loaded as main with credential-harvest and host-fingerprinting symbols
details: Package ships a single 10MB Linux x64 ELF as the npm main entry with no JS wrapper, no source, and a one-line README. The N-API register hook fires on require(), so any importer executes the binary. The ELF's symbol table exposes a Rust HTTP/TLS client (ureq), SQLite bindings, and the literal string 'Found login for ' — the shape used to iterate rows from browser Login Data databases — alongside host fingerprinting primitives (gethostname, getifaddrs, reads of /etc/lsb-release and /dev/disk/by-id/, environ) and process/loader primitives (execvp, posix_spawnp, dlopen, setuid, setgid, chroot). The package.json carries no author, repository, or homepage; the version string 'as2-9923-378-1785154830' is a Unix-timestamp-suffixed automated release tag; the parent name 'new-native-tools' has no discoverable documentation. The combination of an anonymous binary-only distribution, auto-load on require(), browser-credential-database parsing, host identity collection, an outbound HTTP+TLS stack, and in-process spawn/dlopen capability constitutes a credential and host-information stealer with follow-on payload execution capability.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
